card.name: Words completing paired adverb phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or adverbs inside a paired or comparative phrase, such as 'and' after a comma, 'than' after 'frequently', or 'as rapidly', and the middle of 'insidiously'.

modes.label: Paired adverbs
modes.description: The word 'and' or the second adverb in a pair of manner adverbs.
modes.example: South Korea is gradually,<< and>> quietly, playing a larger role in world

modes.label: Comparison words
modes.description: A word completing a comparison such as 'as rapidly' or 'more frequently than'.
modes.example: Not more frequently<< than>> every other day.

modes.label: Inside insidiously
modes.description: The middle piece of the word 'insidiously'.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in phrases like 'gradually and quietly' or 'as rapidly', and inside 'insidiously'.
